title: Paytm Interview Experience (6 Months Intern + FTE)
author: ASHISH ROLAN
body:
I applied for the Data Engineer role (Paytm had two roles: Data Engineer and Cyber Security). I had prepared technologies like Apache Spark, Kafka, Flink, Python, Airflow, and other DE concepts, but interestingly both my rounds were heavily focused on Cyber Security and Network Security only.

Round 1 (Technical):

Started with my project discussion – alternatives, future scope, problems faced.

Asked about Networking, CIA Triad, JWT complete workflow, firewall types and complete working.

Questions on steganography (because one of my projects was on reversible data hiding).

Some basic cyber forensics questions.

Round 2 (Technical + HR, but mostly Technical):

Discussion on my Cyber Security project and real-life use cases and how would you achieve these.

Deep questions on security mechanisms used in backend systems and how they work.

Working of DES and AES encryption and can you use these in your this project if yes then how.

Complete flow of TLS/SSL.

How I would enhance my project using both Data Engineering + Cyber Security concepts.

Ended with HR-style discussion and my questions to the interviewer.

Both interview rounds were around 30-35 min each.

Overall, both rounds were smooth, mainly security-focused even though I opted for Data Engineering.

Within a week I got the result and was selected for the Paytm internship + FTE offer.
